acquisitionMethods.descriptionText: The stone weapons, long since having ceased functioning, naturally blend in with the background.
Even here, a place apparently brimming with life, there are life forms that are dying out.
There are tree trunks hanging up in the air, as it if someone was trying to decorate the empty space above Yolu's Nail.
Once time passes and the vine grows down to the ground, wouldn't it be possible to discover the hidden place above by climbing up the vine?
The waters in Yolu's Nail are not deep, but the effect of piercing sunlight from the darkness conjures images of an abyss.
This damp and humid place has a lot of unknown pteridophyte with dry leaves.
There is a slate in Yolu's Query that Yolu drew upon when brooding about her past. Curiously, it depicts a glorious future.
A slate bearing Yolu's resolve left in Yolu's Nail.
Rocks are strewn everywhere in Yolu's Mane. Is it possible they fell from the top of the wall?
Look for the lava-covered building remains in the Burning Hollow.
The exposed roots of an ancient tree stretch beneath the Kyvelan Track connecting Yolu's Nail and Yolu's Mane.
A shortcut connecting the divided halves of Yolu's Nail. Appears artificial and not naturally made. For what reason though..?
There is a rare plant in Yolu's Mane that grows only in the biome's humid climate.
This well-placed wall has parts that appear to have collapsed. It seems as if something quite large once hit it...
Explore Sol Magia in Yolu's Spine to get information regarding the ever-changing weather in Yolunakea.
Explore Sol Magia in Yolu's Spine if you wish to know about Yolu's concern for the wet weather in Yolunakea.
How could they think of making weapons after seeing the peaceful Oluns? You might get an answer if you explore Sol Magia in Yolu's Spine.
You can find hints of Yolu's obsessive passion for lightstones in areas of Yolu's Spine where the sun doesn't shine.
There is a medicine brewer in Yolu's Pupil that bears not the scent of brewed medicine.
They say people can find a small refuge to shelter themselves from the rain beneath the exposed roots of the tree in Yolu's Mane.
Yolu's hobby was to make bracelets with vines, which she would then give to Dehkima.You can still find some of those bracelets hanging from the tree in Yolu's Pupil.
Careful examination of the layers of dirt that have formed in Yolu's Pupil will reveal much about the diet of the Oluns.
Head to the boulder in Yolu's Mane and you can glimpse upon another of the Olun's traditions.
In Yolu's Garden, leaves sway in the morning breeze, while at, shiny objects fly by.
Recesses large enough to fit several people can be found carved into the walls throughout Yolu's Mane. Is this in the style of the Olun?
The vines hanging upon the walls beyond Yolu's Garden are often used to decorate the homes of the Olun.
A majestic waterfall greets you as soon as you enter Yolu's Garden. The sound of cascading water echoes all around.
Within a small hideout covered in vines below the broken Kyvelan Track, lies a love letter hidden away by someone.
Go up the wall of Yolu's Pupil and you will see Yolu's Query at the top.
A structure full of unknown characters impossible to decipher. Perhaps this is the power source of the Golems...?
No sooner had I approached the shiny lightstone to observe it, it was already too late.
If it wasn't for Orze, Yolu would have been dead already. You can see what transpired in Yolu's Teeth.
If it wasn't for Orze, Yolu would have been dead already. You can see what transpired in Yolu's Teeth.
There's a slate near the central area of Yolu's Teeth that bears the characteristics of Sebekaruk.
As you emerge from a long tunnel, the entirety of Yolu's Teeth welcomes you, ready for you to behold it.
There's a slate in Yolu's Teeth with unappealing scribbles that are nearly illegible due to all the vines covering it.
Do the branches reaching up into the sky wish to be a little closer to the heavens, like a boulder sitting high upon a mountain top?
They say a refreshing wind blows through a gap in the rock wall somewhere in Yolu's Spine.
The roots of this monstrous tree, spread far and wide in clear sight as if holding an enormous structure in the air, is a overwhelming sight to behold.
They say you can hear the humming of Tunta himself near the Sol Magia in Yolu's Garden.

Dive deeply into the waters in Yolu's Garden and they say you can find a slate etched with Yolu's thoughts of despair. Closed off from the outside world, she would often submerge herself in these depths to wrestle with her thoughts. They say you can almost hear Yolu's frustrated whispers echo from within.
Yolu pieced together slates bearing her feelings between the cracks of the pillar in Yolu's Garden without ceasing.

Yolu's thoughts on Orze are scrawled all over a section of the wall in Yolu's Garden. Complete opposites in terms of personality, this fact may have also contributed to Yolu's inherent dislike of Orze.

Most of Yolunakea is covered in green, so the lavender hue of these flowers add some diversity to the somewhat overwhelmingly monotone backdrop of the biome. You can find plenty of these growing around Yolu's Nail.
Unique vegetation found around the medicine brewers specially designed by Yolu.
Lightstones placed atop pillars can be found all over Yolu's Tail. Were they placed to light up the area?
A shining chunk of lightstone found right upon entering Yolu's Tail. Seeing how it's emitting such light on its own, it appears to be of the highest purity.
Unlike other humid areas of Yolunakea, Yolu's Eye is well-lit with sunlight.
A weapon which has lost its function from losing its power source is said to be discarded at Yolu's Pupil.
Somehow, a faint light creeps through the crack between two pillars of different heights that hold up the Kyvelan Track between Yolu's Pupil and Nail.
Kyvelan Tracks designed in a linear fashion. Coinciding with those found in Vahmalkea, these appear to be some of her first designs.
Maybe it was due to a tree root strong enough to pierce sturdy rock? The Kyvelan Track near the large root appears to have been broken off.
Curved Kyvelan Tracks of strange design yet to be observed anywhere else. It appears she didn't copy what she learned from Vaha but improved his designs with her own style.
The door towards Yolu's Teeth is deeply layered upon layers. For what purpose, none are too sure... but one must steel their resolve before heading forward.
Around the border where water gathers in Yolu's Mane, one can spot the source flowing through the rock wall.
A structure greeting all who take a step into Yolunakea. Was it made to detect any intruders?
On the path to Yolu's Nail, there lies tangled vines and a beautiful waterfall coming together to depict the very harmony of nature.
There is an unknown energy in the vicinity of the curved tracks in Yolu's Pupil.
There is something strange about these Stellagia. Did Yolu make them in a manner that was easier for her to control?
These are remnants of a broken lightstone statue. The damage doesn't appear to have been caused by a weapon... Is Yolu the culprit? Let's explore Yolu's Teeth.
There is something resembling a fish scale deep beneath the waters of Yolu's Mane. Could this be traces of a fish-like ancient weapon?
Traces of the desert discovered in Yolu's Spine. Wonder if Vaha left these here?
At the end of Yolu's Tail which is connected to Yolu's Nail, there lies tree roots tangled in a complicated mess.
The stone pillar may have collapsed due to the old tree roots... Even the sturdiest structure falls to nature's might.
A space made by Yolu to enjoy in solitude. Moonlight shines in easily, leading one speculate that could this be where Yolu wrote a love letter for someone special?
At the entrance of Yolu's Mane, an arch-shaped gate of tree roots await all visitors.
A slate with a sun drawn upon it lies beneath the special device designed by Vaha. Yolu made it to express her thankful heart towards Vaha.
The wall in the area with the special device designed by Vaha is covered in vines. Upon a closer look, it becomes apparent that these aren't vines but roots of tree which descends from the skies.

There's fragmented rocks against the rock wall in a section of Yolu's Teeth.
A single pillar supporting the linear Kyvelan Track heading towards the obnoxiously large structure in the center of Yolunakea appears quite dangerous in its cracked and corroded state.
Yolu's promise engraved in the special device designed by Vaha. It bears her resolve to save the future with the other 3 Dehkimas.
